Specification: This module is a test specification for bag (multiset) operators written directly in TLA+, including predicates and constructors such as IsABag, SetToBag, BagCup, BagDiff, BagUnion, SubBag, BagOfAll, BagCardinality, and CopiesIn. It models bags as functions from elements to positive natural multiplicities, defines helper recursion with CHOOSE over finite subsets, and then checks a suite of expected algebraic properties and concrete examples over small bags built from the set {"a", "b", "c"}. The spec is not a fault-tolerant protocol and contains no temporal liveness properties beyond a trivial Init/Next structure; instead, it uses TLC's Print and Assert operators inside an invariant-style predicate Inv to validate correctness of the bag definitions and TLC-handled variants such as MCSubBag.
